name: @compress-bloom-audio/app
description: Bloom Audio Compressor — Neutralino desktop app wrapping the GUI

scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @compress-bloom-audio/lib build && pnpm --filter @compress-bloom-audio/gui build && pnpm --filter @compress-bloom-audio/gui build:server
scripts.dev: pnpm run ensure-framework && pnpm run sync-version && npx --yes @neutralinojs/neu@latest run --disable-auto-reload
scripts.dev:built: pnpm run ensure-framework && pnpm run sync-version && pnpm run build:backend && npx --yes @neutralinojs/neu@latest run --disable-auto-reload
